_comment: Task B0.3: performance budgets, read by tools/check_performance.mjs. Each view's budget is its value in the reference baseline (docs/section-b/baseline/<ref>/baseline.json) times `ratio` plus `plus`. Times are scaled by machine speed (machine.ms now / machine.ms in the reference). The margins cover run-to-run variation measured between two recordings of the same code on the same machine (Nov 26, 2026): CPU work up to 1.5x, frame time up to 1.36x, held frames up to 2.3x; draw calls and GPU memory did not vary. `views` overrides the default for one view. `targets` are fixed limits from the Section B plan; they are reported, and fail the check only with --targets.
